schema.champion_commit: The last CONTENT commit of the generation, by definition. Never the commit that wrote this file: a state file cannot name its own commit, because its bytes are part of the tree that commit hashes. Guarded by tests/test_loop_state_g9.py.
schema.bookkeeping_commit: null at write time, always. Nothing may fill this during the commit that writes the file, because the value would be that commit's own hash. A later generation reading git history may fill it; the null is the record that this one did not.
schema.machinery_commit: The commit every measurement in this generation ran against. One tree, one commit: outputs/g9/manifest.json records it with dirty=false.
schema.results_commit: The commit carrying the artefacts and the result documents. Equal to champion_commit when the generation ends with its results.
schema.baselines: REP-01 as amended at generation 9 section 3: every entry is an OBJECT carrying the invocation that produced it, never a bare scalar. Entries marked rerunnable are re-run by tests/test_loop_state_g9.py and compared; entries that are not carry conditions and measured_at_commit instead, because a number the suite cannot re-derive is only checkable against its conditions.

one_tree_one_commit.note: Every G9 measurement ran against a6728fe. outputs/g9/manifest.json records that commit with dirty=false. The three clean suite timings in baselines.pytest were taken against the same tree, before the commit was made.

spec_clause_status.SPEC-g9-1: PASS as a measurement, and the FALSIFIER FIRES. The four-way ordering was repeated at nine further operating points -- three devices at the 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles of the doping prior, crossed with three bias windows -- under a rule hashed before the first draw. Five distinct orderings appear under the larger-movement statistic and four under the milder one; the generation-8 order is recovered at 2 of 9 and 0 of 9 respectively. Pre-registered as reportable either way (AH-04, AH-13), so the headline converts to 'the ordering is itself operating-point dependent'. The reproduction control re-measures every generation-8 cell through this generation's code and matches.
spec_clause_status.SPEC-g9-2: PASS. rank(observation set) measured as two curves at two stated devices: rank runs 1 -> 4 over bias-window width at a fixed centre and does not move at all over spacing from linear to geometric, each point carrying its own rank(cutoff) curve. Falsifier (a rank on the claim surface at a single window without its curve) is enforced on the prose by tests/test_claim_surface_g9.py; it found 18 live passages across six documents on its first run and does NOT fire now.
spec_clause_status.SPEC-g9-3: PASS, and the FALSIFIER FIRES. All 13 chart-J witness pairs through the generation-6 refinement battery: 7 stay below the floor at N=301/601/1201 and tol_carrier=1e-12; 6 separate. The headline 694 nm / 271 nm pair SURVIVES, its distance falling 1.7%, so the junction non-identifiability claim stands and the count of 13 does not.

Witness pairs clustered by likelihood barrier depth against the floor barrier of 0.5*B = 8.0 log-units, with the mandatory null control in the same record as every count. Falsifier (a basin count without its null control) does NOT fire.

ruling_premises_corrected: Section 2's '44% apart in the observable' could not be re-derived: the figure carried no invocation, which is the defect section 3 of the same ruling is about. Measured on exactly the two cells whose spectra are compared, over exactly the window they are compared in, the distance is 0.82% at the generation-8 operating point and at most 2.67% at any of the twelve. The inference inverts: the spectra agree BECAUSE the two charts put the device in nearly the same place in the observable, while sitting more than 1.2 decades apart in profile space.
Section 3's 'mypy_findings: 25 carries scope and method' is half right. It carries a stated scope and the stated scope is wrong: 25 is mypy src over 44 files; the tracked tree gives 150 over 112.
Section 4's 'static analysis of 96 files' is out of date; the scan covers 110 at this generation, and the direction matters because the unevidenced surface is what grew.

The generation-8 ordering was under-specified before it was unreplicated: its two natural statistics disagree at its own operating point. That is prior to the replication question and would have held had SPEC-g9-1 never run.

Generation 8's 'the number of likelihood basins is larger than the number of profile-distance clusters' is the wrong way round for chart G's witness pairs, whose median barrier is 8.31 log-units against a floor barrier of 8.0. It holds for chart J at d=16.
highest_remaining_scientific_risk: Nothing measured here explains WHY the ordering moves. Nine operating points establish that the relative sensitivity of junction, dimension and interpolant is not a property of this problem, and give no account of what it is a property of. The one axis that is stable -- the observation set, 0.925 to 1.080 across all twelve points -- is stable over three windows inside ONE converged bias range, chosen because the oracle's discretisation error was measured to converge there. A range the solver has not been validated over could behave differently and has not been tried. The honest summary is that generation 9 replaced a false general claim with a true narrow one and a mechanism-shaped hole.
second_remaining_scientific_risk: The barrier metric walks a STRAIGHT LINE in chart coordinates between two members, so every barrier reported is an upper bound on the true barrier -- a curved path can only be shallower. That direction is favourable for the chart-G ridge result, which says barriers are LOW, and unfavourable for the chart-J result, which says they are high: chart J's 468 log-unit median could be smaller along some other path, and no search over paths was run. The null control bounds how much this can matter for the comparison, not for the absolute number.

'the chart does not move the local spectrum at matched d', with or without the interpolant-family qualifier generation 8 added; it moves it by 101.5% at one of the nine points

any rank fraction on the claim surface without the observation set it was measured over, guarded by tests/test_claim_surface_g9.py
